question: FKUZ is related to CORD in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, QJKH is related to NNHL. To which of the following options is JIBP related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef1a08d1ac261dc312fe06bf091df2a759e46479c435e13d4eef66d50fd21097.png] 

The logic followed here is:

FKUZ is related to CORD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bf2bdbca9bb64a3564f12e17b165f7364b03a8c2776f183de4a98e485fa9989.png] 

For, 'QJKH is related to NNHL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92b02066934d69f43d410a27a4f7e59ab03e36e6c2975c6fbac618900d748660.png] 

Similarly, for 'JIBP '

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28d5f9d72f4372c8fb4b024994c1f91917423643ee5049a49a3ff197dd30800b.png]
